verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents asynchronous task delegation by mentioning @gemini-cli in GitHub issues and pull requests, and a community comment refers to this as a GitHub Action, which implies remote, background execution rather than the local terminal. The evidence never describes an isolated cloud sandbox, support for long-running jobs, or background execution semantics, and Cloud Shell availability is a host-platform feature that earns no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit isolated cloud execution environment, documented background or long-running task handling, any description of how delegated tasks run or report results, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment

citations.quote: Mention @gemini-cli in issues and pull requests for help with debugging, explanations, or task delegation
